entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems they finally realized their lives[n]are in danger!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I can't believe they didn't notice until[n]the danger was so close to them...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Things are going to get even worse from[n]here on out...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The entire city has stopped functioning.[n]At least they can still panic for now...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If people still don't act for themselves[n]after seeing all this... I'm sorry, but[n]they're hopeless!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: In any case, let's head to the temple!
